scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check start.js && node --test test/math-response.test.mjs test/game-studio.test.mjs test/argosha.test.mjs test/chat.test.mjs test/deepseek.test.mjs test/admin-auth.test.mjs test/developer-console.test.mjs && node --input-type=module -e 'if(Date.now()>Date.parse("2026-11-25T17:30:00Z")){console.info("[muse-probe] expired");}else{const key=process.env.MUSE_API_KEY?.trim();if(!key){console.info("[muse-probe] missing_key");}else{try{const r=await fetch("https://api.meta.ai/v1/responses",{method:"POST",headers:{Authorization:"Bearer "+key,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({model:"muse-spark-1.3",input:"Reply with only the word OK.",max_output_tokens:512,reasoning:{effort:"low"}}),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000),redirect:"error"});const d=await r.json().catch(()=>({}));const a=(d.output||[]).filter(x=>x.type==="message").flatMap(x=>x.content||[]).filter(x=>x.type==="output_text").map(x=>x.text||"").join(" ").trim();const code=String(d.error?.code||d.error?.type||"").replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g,"").slice(0,80);console.info("[muse-probe] "+JSON.stringify({http:r.status,generated:r.ok&&a.length>0,expected:a==="OK",errorCode:code,usage:Number(d.usage?.total_tokens)||null}));}catch(e){console.info("[muse-probe] transport_error "+(e.name==="TimeoutError"?"timeout":"request_failed"));}}}'
